title: 第9章 猎人规矩会说话的山君第10章 连杀三狼找到狼窟
slug: 打猎娶妻加点我无敌了
lines: 林夜紧紧盯着两人，手里已经准备好弓箭。
同时将1点自由点加在体质，2点加在敏捷上。
但凡他们有点异动，自己也有把握最少解决一个。
却见年长的猎户一把将年轻猎户扯住，朝着林夜拱了拱手。
“小兄弟面生，不知是哪个村子里的猎户？”
林夜满脸警惕，并没有搭话。
对方笑了笑：“我们是靠山屯的，我叫徐虎，这是我侄子徐林。”
听到对方的名字，林夜眼神闪了闪。
他爹以前提起过，这白牛山附近的的猎户，就属靠山屯的徐虎最有本事，以前是边城退下来的弓箭手。
他目光扫了眼徐虎的弓箭，果真是一把强弓，心中艳羡，点点头说道：
“这鹿身上的箭是你们的？”
徐林立马说道：“对啊，这鹿我们追了一个多时辰了，才找到它，结果被你给宰了。”
听那语气，还有些不服气。
徐虎抽出一根箭矢给林夜看了眼，又放了回去。
“我的箭杆有黑漆，一对比便知，小兄弟，咱们直接按照规矩来如何？”
“什么规矩？”林夜问道。
徐林疑惑：“见者有份，按贡献分，这你都不知道？”
徐虎点点头：“这鹿最后是你猎杀的，得拿大头，你占七成，我们三成如何？”
“可以。”
林夜心中悄悄松了口气，他还以为是谁先捕猎算谁的呢。
自己能拿七成到也不亏。
若非对方让母鹿受伤，行动受阻，以母鹿的警惕，还真不一定那么轻松猎到。
何况自己初来乍到，规矩还是得遵守。
于是徐虎抽出猎刀，开始分割鹿肉。
他倒也实诚，将值钱的部分都分给了林夜，自己只留下一些零碎和右后腿。
林夜瞧着那柄寒光凛凛的猎刀，更加羡慕。
再看对方宰割麻利的如庖丁解牛，心中暗道这猎户果然不简单。
还好人是个守规矩的，不然还真是个大麻烦。
分配完，徐林大咧咧的冲他说道：
“你以后可别一个人进深山啊，看见右边那坡了么，附近盘着一窝狼，我们都只敢在这附近转转。”
content_en:
;;
Lin Ye stared at the two of them closely, with a bow and arrow ready in his hand.
At the same time, add 1 freedom point to Constitution and 2 points to Agility.
As long as they make some changes, I am sure to solve at least one of them.
But he saw the older Orion grabbing the young Orion and holding his hand towards Lin Ye.
"We meet each other little brother. I wonder which village he is a hunter from?"
Lin Ye looked wary and did not speak.
The other party smiled: "We are from Guoshantun. My name is Xu Hu, and this is my nephew Xu Lin."
Lin Ye's eyes flashed when he heard the other party's name.
His father had mentioned before that among the hunters near Bainiu Mountain, Xu Hu from the backing village was the most capable. He used to be an archer who had retired from the border town.
He glanced at Xu Hu's bow and arrow. It was really a strong bow. He was envious in his heart, nodded and said:
"Are the arrows on this deer yours?"
Xu Lin immediately said: "Yes, we chased this deer for more than an hour before we found it, but you killed it."
Hearing that tone, he was still a little unconvinced.
Xu Hu took out an arrow, looked at Lin Ye, and then put it back.
"My arrow shaft has black paint. You can tell by comparing it. Little brother, how about we just follow the rules?"
"What rules?" Lin Ye asked.
Xu Lin was puzzled: "Those who meet will be divided according to their contribution. You don't even know this?"
Xu Hu nodded: "You were the one who killed this deer in the end. You have to take the big head. You account for 70%. How about we take 30%?"
"Okay."
Lin Ye secretly breathed a sigh of relief. He thought whoever hunted first would get it.
It’s not a loss if you can get 70% of it.
If the other party had not injured the doe and hindered its movement, it would not have been so easy to hunt it with the doe's vigilance.
Besides, since I'm new here, I still have to abide by the rules.
So Xu Hu took out his hunting knife and began to cut up the deer meat.
He was sincere and gave all the valuable parts to Lin Ye, leaving only some odds and ends and his right hind leg.
Lin Ye looked at the cold hunting knife with even more envy.
Looking at the other party's quick butchery, such as the butler and the cattle, I secretly thought that this hunter is indeed not simple.
Fortunately, he obeys the rules, otherwise it would be a big trouble.
After the assignment, Xu Lin said to him carelessly:
"Don't go into the mountains alone in the future. Did you see the slope on the right? There is a wolf pack nearby. We all only dare to wander around here."
